IVX HOLDINGS — COMPLETE OPERATING MAP, SENIOR DEVELOPER QA, AND END-TO-END VERIFICATION

OBJECTIVE

Map exactly how IVX IA operates today, identify every weak point, fix the execution system, and verify the complete Senior Developer workflow end to end.

Do not return a high-level plan only.
Do not claim Senior Developer status without live proof.

==================================================================
PART 1 — MAP THE CURRENT IVX IA OPERATING SYSTEM
==================================================================

Create a complete operational map covering:

OWNER
→ IVX OWNER AI
→ TASK CLASSIFIER
→ APPROVAL GATE
→ SENIOR DEVELOPER EXECUTOR
→ ENGINEERING TEAMS
→ TEST RUNNER
→ RELEASE MANAGER
→ GITHUB
→ RENDER
→ SUPABASE
→ LIVE HEALTH VERIFICATION
→ DEVELOPER PROOF LEDGER
→ OWNER REPORT

For every component, document:

- component name
- file
- function
- API route
- input
- output
- allowed actions
- prohibited actions
- timeout
- retry behavior
- failure state
- recovery behavior
- owner approval requirement
- evidence produced
- current status

Return the map as:

1. Architecture diagram
2. State-machine diagram
3. Execution sequence
4. Failure and recovery map
5. Deployment authority map

==================================================================
PART 2 — MAP EVERY TASK STATE
==================================================================

Use one canonical task lifecycle:

RECEIVED
→ PERSISTED
→ CLASSIFIED
→ QUEUED
→ ASSIGNED
→ RUNNING
→ WAITING_APPROVAL
→ RETRYING
→ TESTING
→ READY_FOR_RELEASE
→ DEPLOYING
→ VERIFYING
→ VERIFIED

Allowed terminal states only:

VERIFIED
FAILED
BLOCKED
CANCELED

Rules:

- One task may have only one terminal state.
- Never return Completed + Blocked.
- Never return Verified + Failed.
- Never report success without required evidence.
- Never lose a task after timeout, restart, provider failure, or app closure.
- Every state transition must be recorded in the Proof Ledger.

==================================================================
PART 3 — FULL SENIOR DEVELOPER CAPABILITY AUDIT
==================================================================

Test each capability with one real task:

1. Repository inspection
2. Root-cause diagnosis
3. Safe file modification
4. Multi-file refactor
5. Database migration
6. Supabase RLS repair
7. API repair
8. Owner authentication repair
9. Expo mobile repair
10. Reels/media repair
11. Chat repair
12. Typecheck
13. Unit tests
14. Integration tests
15. End-to-end tests
16. Production build
17. Git commit
18. Git push
19. Pull request
20. Owner approval
21. Render deployment
22. Deployment polling
23. Health verification
24. Rollback
25. Emergency stop
26. Retry after 503
27. Retry after timeout
28. Provider failover
29. Queue recovery
30. Proof Ledger generation

For every capability return:

- test task ID
- expected result
- actual result
- PASS / FAIL
- files changed
- evidence
- root cause if failed
- corrective action
- retest result

Do not label IVX Senior Developer VERIFIED unless all critical capabilities pass.

==================================================================
PART 4 — QA THE COMPLETE OWNER AI PATH
==================================================================

Test the real production flow from the owner phone:

OWNER MESSAGE
→ MESSAGE PERSISTED
→ AI DECISION
→ TASK CREATED
→ TASK ASSIGNED
→ WORK EXECUTED
→ TESTS RUN
→ OWNER APPROVAL
→ DEPLOYMENT
→ LIVE VERIFICATION
→ FINAL CHAT REPORT

Test:

- normal chat
- engineering task
- sensitive write action
- database repair
- deployment approval
- task longer than 90 seconds
- app background and reopen
- network interruption
- duplicate send
- provider timeout
- provider 503
- Render restart
- Supabase interruption
- cancellation
- emergency stop

Acceptance criteria:

- no lost message
- no duplicate execution
- no unexplained 503
- no orphaned task
- no contradictory status
- no false VERIFIED claim
- live progress survives restart
- owner receives final evidence automatically

==================================================================
PART 5 — QA THE ENGINEERING TEAMS
==================================================================

Audit all 12 registered teams:

TEAM-01 Architecture
TEAM-02 Frontend
TEAM-03 Backend
TEAM-04 Database
TEAM-05 Media
TEAM-06 QA
TEAM-07 Security
TEAM-08 Performance
TEAM-09 DevOps
TEAM-10 Monitoring
TEAM-11 Business
TEAM-12 Release Manager

For each team verify:

- real implementation exists
- assigned tools work
- permission boundaries work
- one real task completed
- proof ledger entry exists
- no unauthorized deployment ability
- failure recovery works
- status is honest

Return one status per team:

VERIFIED
PARTIAL
FAILED
NOT IMPLEMENTED

Registration in the database alone is not verification.

==================================================================
PART 6 — FIX ALL EXECUTION RELIABILITY ISSUES
==================================================================

Repair all confirmed issues, including:

- HTTP 503 handling
- 60/90-second timeouts
- long-running requests held open
- AI gateway/provider failure
- Render API JSON parsing
- duplicate sends
- contradictory final states
- missing Task ID
- missing files-changed evidence
- stale runtime state
- queue recovery
- app restart recovery
- provider circuit breaker
- retry and failover
- deployment polling
- incorrect health reporting

Required architecture:

1. Persist every task before execution.
2. Return Task ID immediately.
3. Execute long work in a durable background worker.
4. Stream or poll progress.
5. Resume after restart.
6. Use idempotency keys.
7. Use retry with exponential backoff and jitter.
8. Use dead-letter recovery.
9. Use one Release Manager for production.
10. Require owner approval before live deployment.

==================================================================
PART 7 — FULL APPLICATION QA
==================================================================

Run end-to-end QA on:

- Owner login
- Logout/login
- Session persistence
- Owner permissions
- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Properties
- Deals
- Reels
- Media upload
- Chat
- Notifications
- Landing registration
- Waitlist
- Wallets
- Transactions
- KYC
- Admin Hub
- Owner Dashboard
- Variables
- Analytics
- API
- Supabase
- Render
- APK
- Web

Test Android, web, and iOS build readiness.

Return:

- PASS / FAIL
- evidence
- device/platform
- timestamp
- defect ID
- resolution status

==================================================================
PART 8 — DEPLOYMENT AND LIVE VERIFICATION
==================================================================

After all critical fixes pass QA:

1. Run typecheck.
2. Run unit tests.
3. Run integration tests.
4. Run full regression.
5. Run production build.
6. Commit to:
   ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest
7. Push approved branch.
8. Deploy exactly once through TEAM-12 Release Manager.
9. Wait for Render final state.
10. Verify all live endpoints.

Required parity:

GitHub HEAD SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
/health runtime SHA

Required live checks:

- /health/live = 200
- /health/ready = 200
- /health/ai = 200
- /health/database = 200
- /health/queue = 200
- /health/provider = 200

Re-run the complete owner task from the real IVX chat after deployment.

==================================================================
PART 9 — FINAL MANAGEMENT DASHBOARD
==================================================================

Create one Owner Engineering Dashboard showing:

- total tasks
- queued
- running
- waiting approval
- retrying
- failed
- blocked
- verified
- current team assignment
- current file
- current branch
- current commit
- test status
- deployment status
- Render health
- Supabase health
- provider health
- queue depth
- oldest task
- active incident
- last proof ledger entry
- next action

The dashboard must update live.

==================================================================
FINAL EVIDENCE REPORT
==================================================================

Return:

1. Full IVX IA operating map
2. State-machine map
3. Team authority map
4. Capability test table
5. 12-team verification table
6. Full application QA table
7. Root causes fixed
8. Files changed
9. Tests run
10. GitHub commit SHA
11. Render deployment ID
12. Live health results
13. Proof Ledger IDs
14. Remaining blockers
15. Honest Senior Developer score

FINAL STATUS MUST BE EXACTLY ONE:

VERIFIED
FAILED
or BLOCKED

Do not claim IVX is a Senior Developer until the real owner task completes from the live app, passes QA, deploys safely, verifies production, and returns complete proof without manual recovery.
